All 15 checkouts verified at the pinned commits. The contract is React's own-property thenable protocol (`status: 'pending'|'fulfilled'|'rejected'` + `value`/`reason` stamped on the awaitable, as `trackUsedThenable`/`use` require). I traced every producer, shim, and thrower of pending values into a React render across the roster; every path below resolves via `git cat-file -e <commit>:<path>`.
